name: IFEval
intro: IFEval是一个评估大型语言模型遵循自然语言指令能力的基准，解决了人工评测成本高和自动评测偏差问题。包含约500个带有可验证指令（如字数或关键词要求）的提示，实现客观评估。
intro_en: IFEval is a benchmark for evaluating large language models' ability to follow natural language instructions, addressing high costs of human evaluation and biases in automatic evaluation. It includes about 500 prompts with verifiable instructions (e.g., word count or keyword requirements) to enable objective assessment.

drawio_review_note:
Aligned with arXiv:2311.07911. IFEval focuses on objectively verifiable instructions, identifying 25 instruction types and constructing 541 prompts with one or more verifiable instructions. Prompt synthesis proceeds in four stages: generate base prompts with one to three randomly selected instructions, use few-shot prompting to identify and remove illogical prompts, use another few-shot prompting approach to rephrase prompts for phrasing diversity, and manually check/edit every rephrased prompt. Each instruction has a deterministic verification function. Metrics include prompt-level and instruction-level strict accuracy, plus loose accuracy computed after response transformations to reduce false negatives such as harmless markdown formatting.

Bilingual Draw.io bundle synchronized from benchmark_importer after paper and official-source review.
